rule: last block size is nRows % blockSize
message: When nRows is a multiple of blockSize the last block gets 0 rows (nRows % blockSize), so its rows are skipped; use nRows - startRow.

rule: std::mutex instead of the oneDAL threading layer
message: Merging under std::lock_guard<std::mutex> bypasses the threading layer; merge the thread-local ranges in tlsRange.reduce() instead.

rule: DAAL file uses #pragma once instead of #ifndef guard
message: DAAL .i/.h files use #ifndef __COVARIANCE_CONSTANT_COLUMNS_IMPL_I__ include guards, not #pragma once.

rule: hard-coded error message instead of error_messages
message: Add an entry to dal::detail::error_messages instead of a string literal in the throw.

rule: check guarded by cov_matrix instead of cor_matrix
message: The constant-column check runs when result_options::cov_matrix is requested (rejecting valid covariance input) and not for cor_matrix.
